newsitem.title: GERMANY: Holzmann sees smaller oper loss in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Holzmann sees smaller oper loss in 1997.

text.p: German construction group Philipp Holzmann AG said on Wednesday it expected to post a smaller operating loss in 1997 than in 1996 but warned it may have to draw on company assets to ensure an overall break-even result this year.

Holzmann said in a statement released at its annual shareholders' meeting that group construction output rose by 8.4 percent in the first five months of 1997 to 5.0 billion marks ($2.9 billion) from 4.7 billion marks in the year-earlier period. ($ = 1.744 German Marks)
Holzmann, Germany's biggest construction group, predicted construction output for the full year would be unchanged from 1996.
The company in 1996 returned to break-even after huge losses the year before, but only by realising assets.
